verdict.rationale: Granola clearly supports connecting a calendar once (Google/Outlook) to pull meeting events (granola-docs-32, granola-docs-49), and templates let users tailor note formats per meeting type (granola-docs-7/21/36), but there is no evidence of configurable rules that control which meeting types are automatically captured/recorded (e.g., auto-join only for external calls, skip 1:1s, etc.). Missing for 10: documented per-meeting-type auto-capture toggles/rules, admin controls for selective recording, and any independent confirmation that such rules exist.
